description:
The world is wide and full of stories. Your imagination, which had been traveling through your mind non-stop, now unfolds vividly in front of your eyes: a BL anthology connected by keywords of all kinds!

(Source: Manyeo Comics, translated) 

1. **Swii** (쉬이-, Shhh-)
2. **Eotteoke Nahante Ireolsuga** (어떻게 나한테 이럴수가!!, How Could You Do This to Me?)
3-7. **Gumeonggage** (구멍가게, Hole Shop)
8-11. **Dangsineun Seontaekbadeun Jaiji** (당신은 선택받은 자이지, You are the Chosen One)
12-18. **Myeongnangeot** (명란것, Cod Roe)
19-24. **Sambuja** (삼부자, Three Rich Guys)
25-28. **Wang Jin-Ju** (왕진주, King Jin-Ju)
29-35. **Triangle** (트라이앵글, 트라이앵글)
36-37. **Gumeonggage - Yeoreum** (구멍가게-여름, Hole Shop - Summer)
38-43. **Myeongnangeot - Sukseong** (명란것-숙성, Cod Roe - Maturing)
44-45. **Dolsoewa Doryeon-nim** (돌쇠와 도련님, Key and Master)
46-49. **Deot** (덫, Trap)
50. **Chaos** (카오스, Chaos)
51-54. **Full moon**
55-60. **Yeonghuijina** (영희지나)
